question.text: The set that contains atomic numbers of only transition elements, is :

solution.text: A transition element is defined as the one which has incompletely filled d orbitals in its ground state or in any one of the oxidation state. <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Z</mi><mi>n</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>z</mi><mo> </mo><mo>=</mo><mo> </mo><mn>30</mn><mo>)</mo><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>C</mi><mi>d</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>z</mi><mo> </mo><mo>=</mo><mo> </mo><mn>48</mn><mo>)</mo><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>H</mi><mi>g</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>z</mi><mo> </mo><mo>=</mo><mo> </mo><mn>80</mn><mo>)</mo></math> are not transition element.
